title: GA4GH IO Profile Meta-Schema
description: Meta-schema for validating GA4GH workflow and tool IO JSON Schema profiles. The top level requires the inputs/outputs wrapper and may carry the top-level keywords of the workflow vocabulary; every schema, at any depth, must follow the rules of $defs/node, which combines one vocabulary file per keyword group.

allOf.$comment: The keywords of every schema plus the top-level keywords; other x-ga4gh-* keywords are rejected. The check of unevaluated keywords sits in this branch, not at the top level, so that it doesn't evaluate the Draft 2020-12 rules (and with them every nested schema) a second time.

$schema.description: IO schemas must name this meta-schema.

$id.description: The identifier of the IO schema: an absolute URI that is stable and versioned, never the URL of a branch.

not.description: URLs of branches at GitHub and GitLab: refs/heads/ or a common branch name (main, master, dev, develop, HEAD) in place of a tag or commit. A best-effort check: it is case-sensitive and doesn't know other branch names.

inputs.description: JSON Schema block defining the expected input parameters for the workflow or tool.

outputs.description: JSON Schema block defining the outputs of the workflow or tool: an object schema whose properties are the outputs. Optional; without it, the schema describes no outputs.
outputs.$comment: The outputs are the direct properties of this schema, so that normalisers find them without resolving references or applicators.

$comment: The top level takes the Draft 2020-12 rules and the keywords of every schema from $defs/node (without its check of unevaluated keywords), adds the top-level keywords, and rejects other x-ga4gh-* keywords itself. Nested schemas get all of $defs/node, so top-level keywords are rejected there.

node.title: GA4GH IO Profile Schema Rules
node.description: Applies to every schema of an IO schema, at any depth: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 plus the x-ga4gh-* keywords of the vocabularies. Keywords starting with x-ga4gh- that no vocabulary defines are rejected.
node.$comment: The Draft 2020-12 rules, which apply $defs/node to every nested schema, and the check of x-ga4gh-* keywords are separate branches, so that the check of unevaluated keywords doesn't evaluate the Draft 2020-12 rules (and with them every nested schema) a second time; nested schemas would otherwise take time exponential in their depth.

allOf.$comment: Every keyword that doesn't start with x-ga4gh- counts as evaluated; the vocabularies evaluate the x-ga4gh-* keywords they define; any other x-ga4gh-* keyword is unevaluated and rejected.

schema.title: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12
schema.description: The rules of JSON Schema Draft 2020-12. Referenced from within the resource of $defs/node, so that the dynamic scope contains its anchor and the applicators of Draft 2020-12 apply $defs/node to every nested schema. Used by $defs/node and by the top level.

keywords.title: GA4GH IO Profile Keywords
keywords.description: The x-ga4gh-* keywords of every schema, one vocabulary file per keyword group. Used by $defs/node and, without the check of unevaluated keywords, by the top level.
